title: backlog.py module usage text still says to wait on the pid after dispatch --detach prints the coord.py wait --pid command
goal: The --detach paragraph of the module docstring of _tools/backlog.py names the coord.py wait --pid command that dispatch --detach prints and no longer says to wait on the pid

run: import sys;sys.exit(1 if 'wait on the pid' in open('_tools/backlog.py',encoding='utf-8').read() else 0)

import json,subprocess,sys
o=json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbtools.py","--json","backlog dispatch detach wait"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
e=[x for x in o["entries"] if x["tool"]=="backlog.py dispatch"]
t=" ".join(e[0]["answers"]) if e else ""
ok=bool(e) and "coord.py wait" in t and "wait on the pid" not in t
print(ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
